To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the organizational culture of a collective factory is affected by the surrounding social culture of the community.
the organizational culture of kibbutz industries changed from democratic to more hierarchical and autocratic, as a result of privatization of the firm.

the transformation of a collective factory from a democratic to more autocratic management style can be explained by the transformation of the organizational culture from loose to tight, and by the change of the cultural values from collectivistic to individualistic.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between the cultural attributes of a kibbutz and the cultural attributes of its factory.
the cultural changes that have taken place in the factory during the last 20 years, and with the impact of the changes on its organizational structure.
the cultural transformation of a kibbutz enterprise, and its impact on the surrounding community.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the organizational culture of collective factories is a product of the interaction between the organizational structure and the cultural values of the surrounding community.

the cultural transformation of a kibbutz enterprise is a process that is not linear, but rather cyclical, and that the cultural transformation in kibbutz enterprises is a process of change that is not only dependent upon the organizational environment but also on the surrounding community.
privatization of kibbutz enterprises leads to a change in the organizational culture from democratic and egalitarian to more autocratic.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the cultural transformation in a kibbutz is a complex process. It is influenced by the economic and social environment, as well as by the organizational culture.
the organizational culture of a collective factory is a function of the cultural attributes of the surrounding community, and that these attributes change when a community undergoes privatization.
the organizational culture is a reflection of the surrounding community.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the transformation of the organizational culture in a kibbutz is a complex phenomenon, which cannot be explained by the transformation of a single organization or the transformation of the surrounding community alone.
organizational change is not only about the structure, but also about culture and values.
organizational change in kibbutz industries may have a significant impact on the community.
